sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is verified because the feedback requires canonical controlled non-applicable values or terms for propeller and pitch alternatives, while the supplied candidates provide only property terms and no corresponding controlled values.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the hasDesignCondition value is constrained only by an anonymous property shape and is never required to be an instance of its declared canonical range nltl:designCondition, so an arbitrary node with matching booleans can satisfy the rule. Add sh:class nltl:designCondition to the hasDesignCondition property shape (or to the nested node shape) while retaining the existing design-condition constraints.

The prior class-range repair is present, but the applicability alternative is still semantically unsafe.
